title: TicZ-Study: The effect of a two-week morning light therapy (Bright Light Therapy, BLT) on children and adolescents with tic and obsessive-compulsive disorders
summary: The study examines the extent to which two weeks of morning light therapy (Bright Light Therapy, BLT) can lead to a reduction in neuropsychiatric symptoms and an improvement in sleep quality and general mental well-being in children and adolescents with tic and/or obsessive-compulsive disorders.
conditions: Children and adolescents aged 12-17;11 years with tic and/or obsessive-compulsive disorders

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Tic or obsessive-compulsive disorders or a combination of both disorders
Exclusion criteria:
No tic or obsessive-compulsive disorder
Eye diseases such as glaucoma or cataracts, diseases of the retina as well as the skin disease lupus
If taking antibiotics, participation must be postponed or paused
